transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I've just gotten so incredibly slowed down lately. I'm an auditor, and lately, I can just sit there, staring at a single workpaper for like twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type a number. It's like I'm moving through molasses. And... people at work have started noticing that I'm just not keeping up anymore.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you usually like doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to do quite a bit outside of work. I'd plan hikes, take photos, cook big meals on Sundays... I even volunteered at the library. But now... I don't know. All of those things just feel like items on a checklist. I just really don't care enough to even try to start them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about seven months now. It started right around the time my husband stopped working... his company went through a downsizing. So, yeah, about seven months of feeling this way.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt slowed down, lost interest in things, and struggled to enjoy activities?
No, I haven't. This is the first time I've ever felt like this. I've always been pretty active and on top of things, so feeling this... sluggish and empty, it's all new to me.
Have you ever had any other episodes in your life where you felt down, slowed down, or lost interest in things for a period of time, even if they didn't last as long as this one?
No, I really haven't. Like I said, this is all completely new for me. I've never gone through a patch like this before, not even for a short time.
Have you experienced any significant stressors or traumatic events in the past seven months, aside from your husband's job loss?
No, not really. It's just been the thing with his job. Everything else has been pretty normal, I guess. Just... just that one big thing.
Have you had any unusual experiences lately, such as hearing voices, feeling extremely paranoid, or feeling so slowed down that you can barely move?

Well, I haven't really felt paranoid, and I can still move around, even if it feels harder than usual. But... I have been hearing something weird. Sometimes when I'm working, like if I open up a spreadsheet or check my email, I hear this voice. It sounds really clear, like it's coming from right behind my laptop screen. It just says, "You missed it, they know." And... I know there's no one else in the room with me. It's just me. But I hear it.
Do these voices happen only when you're feeling especially down or slowed, or do you hear them even when you're not feeling that way?

It's only been since I started feeling this way. I never heard that voice before... or, you know, believed that the firm was secretly building a case against me. None of that happened before this whole feeling settled in. Those experiences really only started after my mood and my energy had already been low for a while.
Have you ever experienced a time when your mood was unusually elevated, you felt extremely energetic, or you needed less sleep but still had lots of energy?

No, I've never had anything like that. I've always just been... pretty steady, I guess, before all this started. I've never felt unusually energetic or like I didn't need sleep. If anything, I just feel tired all the time lately. But no, never any periods of feeling really high or super energetic.
Have you had days where you felt this way for most of the day, nearly every day, or does it come and go more randomly?

I'm not really sure. I haven't been keeping track of it that closely, honestly. Um... it just feels like I'm tired and down a lot, but I couldn't tell you if it's literally every single day for most of the day, or if it fluctuates more than that. It all just kind of blurs together at this point.
Do you think your low mood and slowed-down feelings would still be this severe even if your husband hadn't lost his job, or do you feel like your reaction is mostly tied to that event?

I don't really know. I mean, my husband losing his job was definitely stressful, but... I don't think it's just that. It's hard to say if it would be this bad without it. I just feel so drained and heavy, and I'm not sure if it's all because of his job or if it's something else. It just feels like everything is piling up.
Do you believe that others around you know something is wrong with you, or have you felt like people are talking about you or plotting against you?

I don't think people are plotting against me, exactly. It's more... I just know I've messed everything up. My husband keeps showing me our bank statements, trying to prove we have money, but I know it's not real. I know I've ruined us financially. And at work... my manager tells me my job is safe, but I know they're just saying that. I know they're quietly putting together a case to fire me and expose how incompetent I am. It doesn't matter what they say, I just know it's true.
